methodology_source.note: Source was directly inspected. No embedded Word comments or tracked changes were found; separate adviser comments were not available.

implementation_candidate.value: Researcher must select and approve a positive integer; Chapter 3 does not specify this model setting.

framework_data_lock.note: Versions are specified by Chapter 3 Section 3.2.3 and Table 3.1. Official criteria/weight sources and their locked digests have not been supplied or verified.

institutional_evidence.required: Official institutional evidence supplied by participating HEIs with formal authorization/DUA; source/date/page-or-section/unit traceability and authenticity/readability/relevance screening.

expert_validation.note: Five-reviewer persistence/API and Fleiss' kappa integration are implemented, but no actual expert qualifications or judgments are present. ICC(2,1) is diagnostic only; expert eligibility, consensus, ICC model, missingness, and interpretation rules still require researcher/adviser approval.

framework_scoring.ahp_scope: Subcriteria or operational mappings without directly usable official weights

ablations.A4: A3 + XAI; evaluate XAI separately from numerical score improvement

retrieval_evaluation.note: K = 1, 3, and 5 is specified in Chapter 3. Query unit, candidate-pool rule, eligibility, aggregation, undefined-metric behavior, and tie-breaking below remain implementation candidates only; Chapter 3 does not specify them.

indicator_configuration.note: Digest identifies the current provisional code catalog; authoritative provenance and approval are missing.

decisions_requiring_researcher_approval: Obtain and verify the official criteria and published weights for the four Table 3.1 framework editions; record authoritative sources and locked digests.
Obtain authorized HEI institutional evidence, source provenance, DUA/institutional clearance, and privacy approval; the WURI workbook pilot is not that corpus.

Approve expert eligibility criteria and the consensus/adjudication procedure; verify genuine qualifications and obtain five independent judgments per case. The five-review infrastructure and Fleiss' kappa integration exist, but no real reviews are present.
Select and approve the ICC model, complete-case/missing-rating policy, minimum case requirements, and agreement interpretation rules. The ICC(2,1) output is a diagnostic candidate only.
Specify the rubric anchors and rater instructions for completeness, source reliability, and evidence strength.
Select the calibrated model-confidence computation and its calibration procedure.
Specify criterion aggregation from multiple/contradictory/missing/duplicate/stale evidence into x_fj.
Approve the operational definition of balanced precision-recall behavior and threshold tie-breaking while preserving validation-only calibration and a locked test set.
Approve retrieval query unit, candidate pool, query eligibility, metric aggregation, undefined-metric behavior, and tie-breaking. P@K/R@K cutoffs K = 1, 3, 5 are specified by Chapter 3.
Select the exact pretrained baseline identity/revision and approve its artifact provenance, checksum, and model-specific settings, which Chapter 3 does not specify.

Approve the additional leakage grouping/normalization/shingle/Jaccard/seed choices; Chapter 3 specifies stratification by framework and major indicator group where sample size permits, not those implementation details.
Confirm/approve the proposed five-point close-margin rule through expert validation before final evaluation and approve readiness interpretation bands.
Implement and verify the full Chapter 3 A0 conventional Sentence-BERT + AHP-TOPSIS baseline and A1-A4 configurations; the current A0 executor is retrieval-only.
Provide separate adviser comments if applicable; none were embedded in the reviewed DOCX.
